title: Paul's fear for the church in Corinth
description: Paul expresses fear about what he will find upon his arrival in Corinth: strife, jealousy, anger, selfish ambition, slander, gossip, arrogance, and disorder. He fears that God may have to humble him again among them, and that he must mourn over many who have sinned and not repented of impurity, sexual immorality, and debauchery.
